description: Audit follow-up from fz-go4.18.3.2.4 (non-blocking). The retraction scheme's distinct-cell guarantee rests on return_demand_contributors[t] and return_demands keeping lockstep (a target is in one iff in the other). recompute_return_demand maintains this, but it's a CONVENTION, not enforced — a future caller mutating one map without the other would silently desync and reintroduce the unknown-is-not-none conflation. Add a debug_assert tying contributors[t] non-emptiness to return_demands.contains(t) (and vice versa) so the invariant is enforced rather than conventional. Trivial, defensive.
title: Enforce PullSession return-demand map-lockstep invariant with a debug-assert
